label: Abbreviation
definition: A common abbreviation for the name or label of a class.

label: Accession Catalogue
definition: Identifier of an accessions catalogue or numbering scheme which contains the SpecimenUnit

label: Accession Lineage
definition: The purpose of this property is to trace the lineage of an accession to either one or two immediate parent unit ID's.

label: Accession Material Type
definition: The type of material the current living accession is composed of.

label: Accession Name
definition: A name given to the accession that cannot be covered by abcd:BotanicalScientificName (i.e. not a formal cultivar or trade designation name).

label: Accession Name Text
definition: Alternative concatenated representation for Accession Names.

label: Accession Number
definition: The institutional number applied to the accession and recorded in the accessions register.

label: Accession Specimen Numbers
definition: The minimum numbers of individuals the garden is holding under the UnitID.

label: Accession Status
definition: The current status of the accession in the garden (current or not current).

label: Accuracy
definition: A statement of accuracy concerning the measurement.

label: Acquisition Source Text
definition: Free text field for unformatted recording of acquisition source details.

label: Acquisition Type
definition: Type of acquisition of specimen.

label: Acronym
definition: The accepted acronym for the virus.

label: Address
definition: A string representing a postal address.

label: Age
definition: The age of the organism at the time of collection or observation.

label: Ancestral Data
definition: Information about either pedigree or other description of ancestral information (i.e. parent variety in case of mutant or selection). [FAO/IPGRI multi-crop passport descriptor (MCPD)]

label: Applies To
definition: Property to specify the actual part of a subject that was measured.

label: Area Class
definition: Allows the recording of classification categories for the class of the gathering named area (local or national subdivision levels, geomorphological units, protected areas, etc.)

label: Aspect Ratio
definition: The ratio of the frame dimensions expressed as a fraction of width and height.

label: Association Type
definition: Description of the type of association which the associated Unit has to a Unit.

label: Audio Bitrate
definition: The bit rate of the audio stream, usually expressed in kBit/s.

label: Audio Channel
definition: Channel(s) used for recording audio track.

label: Author Team
definition: The author(s) who published the full name as it stands.

label: Author Team And Year
definition: The author(s) who published the full name as it stands and its year.

label: Author Team Original And Year
definition: The first person(s) who validly published the species-group name and the year of publication.

label: Author Team Parenthesis
definition: Author team of the basionym of a species or subspecies combination.

label: Author Team Parenthesis And Year
definition: The parenthetical citation of the original author when a species-group was transferred to another genus and the year of the original publication.

label: Biological Status
definition: Code for the (propagation-)provenance of the unit.

label: Blocked
definition: Sample or specimen data can not be ordered/loaned in general, but are visible via portals.

label: Breed
definition: Name of the breed of an animal.

label: Breeding Country Code
definition: ISO 3-letter code for the country where the breeding institute is located.

label: Breeding Institution Code
definition: FAO Institute Code of the institute that has bred the material.

label: Breeding System
definition: A code to indicate the breeding system of the accession [ITF-2].

label: Brightness
definition: This property describes the average scene luminance ("brightness") of the APEX exposure model.

label: Call Type
definition: The type of animal call that is recorded.

label: Capture Equipment
definition: The equipment used to create this multimedia object.

label: Capture Framerate
definition: The number of frames a video was captured with. If this number is higher than the (playback) framerate the video is a high-speed capture (slow-motion video) and if it is lower it is a time-lapse recording.

label: Carrier Frequency
definition: For describing the sound or call of an animal.

label: Classification Scheme
definition: The classification system used to describe a concept. This can also be used to document the controlled vocabulary used.

label: Code
definition: An abbreviation or code for a concept.

label: Code Assessment
definition: An indication of whether the type is conserved or rejected/suppressed by the Code, or is proposed for conservation or suppression/rejection.

label: Code Standard
definition: The standard coding scheme an abcd:Code is using.

label: Codec Name
definition: Name and version (or subtype) of the compression algorithm used.

label: Codec Quality
definition: Impact of the compression on quality.

label: Collecting Acquisition Source
definition: Code for the (location-) provenance of the unit.

label: Color
definition: Property to indicate the color range recorded in this image.

label: Color Space
definition: The color space used to store the image in.

label: Combination Author Team And Year
definition: The citation of the authors responsible for the new combination and the year of its publication.

label: Completeness
definition: An indication of the completeness of the representation of an organism in a paleontological specimen.

label: Contrast
definition: This property indicates the direction of contrast processing applied by the camera when the image was shot.

label: Contributors
definition: Contributors or translators for a class expressed in a free text form.

label: Coverage
definition: Free-form text terminology or descriptions available in a data source (geographic, taxonomic, etc.).

label: Creators
definition: Author(s) or editor(s) of a class expressed in a free text format.

label: Cultivar Group Name
definition: The cultivar group name.

label: Cultivar Name
definition: A cultivar name, as specified by the ICNCP.

label: Cultivated Occurrence
definition: Records whether the plant is established or not established (hence, only maintained as a cultivated plant), in the collection habitat. Equivalent to HISPID:poscul.

label: Cultivation
definition: Allows for cultivation information to be passed as free text in order to help the receiving garden care for the transferred accession [ITF-2] or to record the garden's experience made with this accession.

label: Culture Medium
definition: The growth medium for a microbial or similar culture.

label: Culture Name
definition: The reference or trade name for a microbial culture.

label: Data Center
definition: The name of the institution or data center which is hosting a dataset. This might be different from (the institution of) the owner.

label: Decoded Breeding Institute
definition: A brief name and location for a breeding institute.

label: Decoded Gathering Institute
definition: The brief name and location of a donor institute.

label: Decoded Location Safety Duplicates
definition: Brief name and location of the institute maintaining the safety duplicate.

label: Derived Flag
definition: A flag indicating that the information connected to a class is derived rather than original data.

label: Details
definition: Detailed information related to a class.

label: Digital Zoom Ratio
definition: This property indicates the digital zoom ratio when the image was shot.

label: Direct Access URL
definition: An electronic source of the dataset that allows for querying and downloading of the data.

label: Disposition
definition: The current disposition of the catalogued item.

label: Division
definition: Part of an Organization, e.g. department or section.

label: Donor Category
definition: A code to indicate the type of the immediate donor from which the accession was obtained. This may not be necessarily the original collector of wild material. [ITF-2]

label: Doubtful Flag
definition: An indicator for unverified type status (kind and fact).

label: Duplicates Distributed To
definition: Institutions that received duplicates of this specimen, preferably in the form of a delimited list of SourceInstitionIDs.

label: Duration
definition: The duration of a measurement or recording.

label: Duration Time Code
definition: The duration of the recording expressed as a time code.

label: Email Address
definition: An e-mail address of a contact.

label: EPSG ID
definition: The EPSG code of the coordinate reference system used for the coordinates.

label: Error Distance In Meters
definition: An estimate of how tightly the coordinates were specified, expressed as a distance in meters corresponding to a radius around the coordinates.

label: Error Method
definition: A free text statement of how the Coordinate Error was determined.

label: Establishment Means
definition: The historical relationship of the occurrence to the cited time and place of collection or observation.

label: Exact Value
definition: The exact value of a measurement.

label: Exposure Mode
definition: This property indicates the exposure mode set when the image was shot. This is an EXIF term.

label: Exposure Time
definition: EXIF term. Exposure time, given in seconds.

label: Exsiccatum
definition: Information relating a specimen to an Exsiccatum.

label: f Number
definition: The ratio of the focal length of the camera to the diameter of the lens pupil (aperture).

label: Field Notes
definition: Notes taken in the field for the object or observation.

label: File Format
definition: A code or descriptive term for the file or object format.

label: File Size
definition: The size of the file of the multimedia object.

label: File URL
definition: The URL to directly access the underlying multimedia file.

label: First Epithet
definition: The first epithet in a botanical name combination identified for the unit(species epithet or the epithet of the subdivision of a genus).

label: Flash
definition: This tag indicates the flash status when the picture was taken, as a human readable value.

label: Flash Energy
definition: Indicates the strobe energy at the time the image is captured, as measured in Beam Candle Power Seconds (BCPS).

label: Focal Length
definition: The actual focal length of the lens, in mm.

label: Focal Length In 35 mm Film
definition: This tag indicates the equivalent focal length assuming a 35 mm film camera, in mm.

label: Footprint Spatial Fit
definition: A measure of how well the geometry expressed in the abcd:FootprintWKT match the original spatial representation, as a ratio of the area of the footprint given to the area of the original spatial representation.

label: Footprint WKT
definition: A Well-Known Text (WKT; see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Well-known_text) representation of the shape (footprint) that defines the gathering site.

label: Form
definition: The original or a mold, cast etc. of the specimen.

label: Form Of Supply
definition: Form in which the strain will be sent to the customer.

label: Framerate
definition: The number of frames per second a video file is supposed to be played at.

label: Full Name
definition: String of the preferred form of personal name for displaying.

label: Full Scientific Name
definition: A concatenated scientific name formed in the unit identification.

label: Gamma
definition: Indicates the value of coefficient gamma used in gamma correction.

label: Gathering Institution Code
definition: FAO Code of the institution responsible for the collection of the unit.

label: Genotype
definition: Names of chromosomal markers of the strain.

label: Genus Or Monomial
definition: The genus as part or only result of an identification or a higher taxon name representing that result.

label: Geoecological Term
definition: An area name describing the - or part of the - geoecological scope of a data set.

label: Given Names
definition: The name of a person, which is the first or Christian name in western cultures as well as any additional given names e.g. middle name.

label: Grid Cell Code
definition: The code of the grid system used to record coordinates.

label: Grid Cell System
definition: The name of the grid system used for grid coordinates.

label: Grid Qualifier
definition: A grid reference precision qualifier for coordinates.

label: Growth Conditions Text
definition: An alternative full text field for the culture medium, atmospheric and light conditions, temperature conditions, and additional remarks on the cultivation.

label: GUID
definition: The globally unique identifier of a class.

label: Hardiness
definition: A flag indicating that the accession is grown outdoors in the botanical garden.

label: has Accession
definition: Property to connect a concept to an accession.

label: has Acknowledgement
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to acknowledgement information (e.g. to declare grant money, help, permissions to reuse published materials, related scientific work used).

label: has Acquisition Date
definition: Property to connect a specimen to the date of acquisition of the specimen by the institution.

label: has Altitude
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to an altitude of a gathering site land or floor level given as distance above (positive) or below mean sea level. Represented as Measurement Or Fact.

label: has Annotation
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to an Annotation.

label: has Annotator
definition: Property to connect an Annotation to a Contact as its author.

label: has Aspect
definition: Property to connect to the facing direction (aspect) of whole site or sample point. Represented as Measurement Or Fact.

label: has Assemblage
definition: Property to connect a Unit to an Assemblage to describe symmetric relationships between several Units.

label: has Association
definition: Property to connect a Unit to an Association to describe an asymmetric relationship between two Units.

label: has Author
definition: Property to connect a concept to a person as author.

label: has Biostratigraphic Term
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a  biostratigraphic zonation term expressing stratigraphy at a location (e.g. Psiloceras planorbis zone).

label: has Biotope
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Biotope.

label: has Blocked Until Date
definition: Property to connect a concept to a date or year until a specimen or sample is not available for loan, often due to planned publications.

label: has Botanical Taxon Rank
definition: Property to connect a concept to a botanical taxon rank.

label: has Chronostratigraphic Term
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a chronostratigraphic dating term expressing stratigraphy at a location.

label: has Contact
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Contact.

label: has Content Contact
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Contact that is responsible for its content.

label: has Coordinates
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to Coordinates.

label: has Country
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Country.

label: has Creator
definition: Property to connect a concept to its creator.

label: has Data Set
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a data set.

label: has Date
definition: Connects an instance of a class to a Date.

label: has Date Created
definition: Connects a class to the date it was created.

label: has Date Modified
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to the date it was last modified/edited.

label: has Depth
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to the vertical distance point or range measurement in relation to a ground datum such as water level, or level of the sea floor for benthic samples.. Represented as Measurement Or Fact.

label: has Field Note Reference
definition: Property to connect a Unit to a Reference where corresponding Field Notes are published.

label: has Field Number
definition: Property to connect a Unit or a Gathering Agent (Contact) to a Field Number.

label: has File Format Version
definition: Property to connect a concept to a File Format Version.

label: has Gathering
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a gathering event.

label: has Gathering Agent
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Person as gathering agent.

label: has Growth Condition
definition: Property to connect a culture unit to growth conditions.

label: has Height
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to the vertical distance measure or range in relation to a ground datum, e.g. ground level. Represented as Measurement Or Fact.

label: has Higher Taxon
definition: Property to connect an Identified Taxon to a Higher Taxon.

label: has Higher Taxon Rank
definition: Property to connect a Higher Taxon to a rank higher than genus.

label: has Identification
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to an Identification.

label: has Identification Source
definition: Property to connect an Identification to the Reference which has provided the Unit Identification (and - if present - the identifier's name and/or organization).

label: has Identified Taxon
definition: Property to connect an Identification to the Identified Taxon.

label: has Identifier
definition: Property to connect an Identification to the Person (Contact) who issued it.

label: has Inverse Association
definition: A property to link an Association to its inverse.

label: has Last Editor
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to the Contact that created or last edited it.

label: has License
definition: Property to connect a class to the license that applies to it.

label: has Lithostratigraphic Term
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a lithostratigraphic term describing geology at a location (e.g. Mercia Mudstone Group).

label: has Loan Date
definition: Property to connect a concept to the date it was lent.

label: has Loan Restrictions
definition: Property to connect a concept to restrictions for accessing or loaning a specimen or sample.

label: has Loan Return Date
definition: Property to connect a concept to the date it has to be returned and the loan ends.

label: has Mark
definition: Property to connect a concept to a mark.

label: has Measurement Or Fact
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Measurement Or Fact.

label: has Measuring Agent
definition: Property to connect a Measurement Or Fact to the Contact it was done by.

label: has Multimedia Object
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Multimedia Object.

label: has Named Area
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Named Area.

label: has Named Place Relation
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Named Place Relation.

label: has Nomenclatural Type Designation
definition: Property to connect a concept to its nomenclatural type designation.

label: has Nomenclature Code
definition: Property to connect an Identified Taxon to a Nomenclature Code.

label: has Organization
definition: Property to connect a class to an Organization.

label: has Other Legal Statement
definition: Connects an instance of a class to an associated Legal Statement that can not be expressed by abcd:hasLicense, abcd:hasAcknowledgement or abcd:hasSuggestedCitation such as disclaimers and usage restrictions.

label: has Owner
definition: Property to connect a class to a Contact acting as or representing the legal owner of it.

label: has Permit
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Permit.

label: has Permit Status
definition: Property to connect a Permit to a Permit Status. Material collected after 2014-10-12 cannot be in "Unknown" Permit Status!

label: has Permit Type
definition: Property to connect a Permit to a Permit Type.

label: has Person
definition: Property to connect a class to a Person.

label: has Planting Date
definition: Property to connect a concept to the date it was planted.

label: has Preparation
definition: Property to connect a concept to information about preparation.

label: has Preparation Agent
definition: Property to connect a preparation to the person and/or institution responsible for or effecting the preparation of the specimen.

label: has Preservation
definition: Property to connect a concept to a preservation.

label: has Previous Unit
definition: Property to connect a unit to a predecessor.

label: has Project
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Project.

label: has Record Basis
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Record Basis.

label: has Reference
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to an associated Reference.

label: has Scientific Name
definition: Property to connect an Identified Taxon to its Scientific Name.

label: has Sequence
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a genomic Sequence.

label: has Sequencing Agent
definition: Property to connect a Sequence to the responsible agent.

label: has Sex
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Sex.

label: has Source Reference
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to  a reference to the source of the information connected to it. This is usually the published reference from where the information originated.

label: has Stratigraphic Term
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a stratigraphic term.

label: has Suggested Citation
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a citation indicating how the instance should be attributed when cited externally.

label: has Synecology
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Synecology.

label: has Taxon In Background
definition: a property to denote a taxon in the background of a multimedia object

label: has Technical Contact
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to a Contact that is responsible for technical issues in its context.

label: has Temperature
definition: Property to connect a concept to a temperature.

label: has Temperature Scale
definition: Property to connect a temperature to the temperature scale it uses.

label: has Type Specific Information
definition: Property to connect an instance of a class to information specific to the type of the Unit.

label: has Typified Name
definition: Property to connect a Nomenclatural Type Designation to a scientific name as its typified name.

label: has Unit
definition: A property that connects an instance of a class to a Unit.

label: has Unit Reference
definition: Property to connect a Unit to a published Reference citing it.

label: has Verification Date
definition: Property to connect a concept to a date of verification.

label: has Verifier
definition: Property to connect a concept to a person as its verifier.

label: has Version
definition: Connects an instance of a class to its version.

label: Height
definition: An image or video height in pixels.

label: Hybrid Flag
definition: A flag indicating that the unit identified is a named hybrid or a graft chimaera.

label: Hybrid Flag Insertion Point
definition: An indicator of the insertion point of the abcd:hybridFlag.

label: ID
definition: Code or Identifier of a class (unique within its local context).

label: Identification History
definition: The history of identifications for a Unit (assigned identification results).

label: Identification Qualifier
definition: A term to qualify the Identification of a Unit when doubts have arisen as to its identity (e.g. "cf." or "aff.").

label: Identification Qualifier Insertion Point
definition: An indicator of the insertion point of the abcd:identificationQualifier.

label: Identified Material
definition: A material identified as the result of the unit identification event (e.g. a non-organismic substrate of a microorganism).

label: Image Resolution
definition: The resolution of an image resolution expressed in dots per inch.

label: Informal Name
definition: The outcome of an Identification event for a Unit that does not adhere to the rule of a Code of Nomenclature. This includes common or vernacular names.

label: Information Withheld
definition: Brief descriptions of additional information that may exist, but that has not been made public.

label: Infraspecific Epithet
definition: The final epithet of a botanical name of infraspecific rank.

label: Infrasubspecific Name
definition: The variety designation, epithet, authors and reference for the unit.

label: Inherited Name
definition: The inherited part of the name of a person. This may consist of family names, generational names, a clan name, parents or grandparents personal names, etc.

label: IPEN
definition: A unique number given to plant materials accessioned in conformance with the rules of the International Plant Exchange Network.

label: Is Quantitative
definition: A flag indicating whether values given for a measurement represent the numerical result of a quantitative measurement ("true") or a descriptor with textual or categorical result ("false").

label: ISO Speed
definition: This tag indicates the ISO speed value of a camera or input device that is defined in ISO 12232. When recording this tag, the abcd:PhotographicSensitivity properties shall also be recorded.

label: ISO3166Code
definition: A 2-letter (ISO3166-1) or 4-letter (ISO3166-3, for historic countries) code for representation of the name of the country or origin.

label: Kind Of Unit
definition: Part(s), physical state, or class of materials represented by the Unit.

label: Latitude Decimal
definition: The latitude of a location (north-south component), expressed in decimal degrees. The values range from -90 to 90.

label: Latitude Text
definition: A free text format for the latitude component of the coordinates that are not expressed in a pure decimal format.

label: Lens Model
definition: This element records the lens’s model name and model number as an ASCII string.

label: Lichen Morphotype
definition: The name of an algal or cyanobacterial component of lichen.

label: Light Condition
definition: Description of light conditions during recording.

label: Light Source
definition: The kind of light source.

label: Loan Conditions
definition: Certain conditions for loaning this specimen or sample.

label: Loan Destination
definition: Institution to which the loan is being sent [HISPID3].

label: Loan Dispatch Method
definition: The means by which the loan is being dispatched from the home institution [HISPID3].

label: Loan For Botanist
definition: Name of the botanist for whom the loan is destined [HISPID3].

label: Loan ID
definition: The unique institutional loan number applied with the loan sequence number to uniquely identify a specimen on loan [HISPID3].

label: Loan Sequence Number
definition: The sequence of a specimen within a given loan, assigned with the Loan Identification to uniquely identify a specimen on loan [HISPID3].

label: Locality Text
definition: The original gathering locality data as appearing on a label or in an original entry. It should contain the information below the country level that describes where the accession was collected.

label: Location In Garden
definition: The current location of the living plant in the botanical garden.

label: Location Safety Duplicates
definition: The FAO Institute Code of the institute where a safety duplicate of the accession is maintained.

label: Logo URL
definition: URL of an icon/logo symbolizing the associated class.

label: Longitude Decimal
definition: The longitude of a location (east-west component), expressed in decimal degrees. The values range from -180 to 180.

label: Longitude Text
definition: A free text format for the longitude component of the coordinates that are not expressed in a pure decimal format.

label: Lower Value
definition: The lower value of a measurement when it yields a range of values.

label: Major
definition: A major version number.

label: Maker Note
definition: A tag for manufacturers of e.g. Exif/DCF writers to record any desired information. The contents are up to the manufacturer, but this tag shall not be used for any other than its intended purpose.

label: Mark Type
definition: The type of mark on or associated to the unit - a label or an inscription.

label: Matrix
definition: The sediment or mineral matrix enclosing the fossil.

label: Method
definition: Property to describe the method used to determine a corresponding result.

label: Microphone
definition: Microphone equipment used for recording audio track.

label: Mineralization
definition: The form of mineralization.

label: Minor
definition: An optional minor version number.

label: Modifier
definition: Text specifying a status and optional number for a version.

label: Multimedia Context
definition: The context of the multimedia object in relation to the specimen or observation.

label: Mutant
definition: Type and parent of the mutant if the strain is a mutant strain.

label: Mycological Live Stage
definition: A spore state that is present in the sample.

label: Name
definition: The name of a class in a specific language.

label: Name Addendum
definition: A free-text suffix added to the Scientific Name of the Identified Taxon, including additional name element in common use but without formal nomenclatural standing (e.g. isolate names for viruses).

label: Name Approbation
definition: Approbation of the name identified for a unit according to an approved list, validation list,or validly published, paper in IJSB after 1980.

label: Name Prefix
definition: The prefix for the Inherited Name of a Person.

label: Name Suffix
definition: The suffix for the Inherited Name of a Person.

label: Named Collection Or Survey
definition: A named collection or survey project to which the Unit belongs, which may not match the abcd:SourceID.

label: Named Individual
definition: The name of an individually named animal.

label: National Inventory Code
definition: A code identifying the National Inventory. The code of the country preparing the National Inventory. Exceptions are possible, if agreed with EURISCO such as NGB.

label: Natural Occurrence
definition: Records whether the plant is a native of the collection habitat or whether it is a naturalised introduction. Equivalent to HISPID:posnat.

label: Nearby Place Name
definition: A named place near or otherwise related to - but not naming - the gathering site.

label: Nearby Place Relation
definition: The relation of the location to a nearby named place.

label: Negative Identification Flag
definition: This flag is set to "true" to designate a negative identification.

label: Nomenclatural Type Text
definition: A note detailing possible or verified type information related to the specimen.

label: Notes
definition: Supplementary remarks about a concept.

label: Number Of Notes
definition: The number of notes the animal in the recording makes.

label: Numeric Unit ID
definition: The numeric catalogue number for a Unit. Where present, the unit catalogue number facilitates sorting and allows for searches on a range of catalogue numbers.

label: Observation Unit ID
definition: Numbers or other registration mark associated with an observation record.

label: Organism Type
definition: The type of organism.

label: Other Identification
definition: Any other identification (numbers) known to exist in other collections for this accession.

label: Other Provider
definition: The URI of another provider known to serve this dataset, usually expressed as an http URI or a UUID.

label: Paleontological Time Range
definition: Known or assumed time range of a fossil.

label: Parabola
definition: The kind of parabola used for the microphone when recording from a distance.

label: Parameter
definition: A parameter to which the result of a measurement is assigned.

label: Parenthetical Author Team And Year
definition: Author team and Year of the basionym of a species or subspecies combination.

label: Pathovar
definition: Name and author of a pathovar.

label: Perennation
definition: A code to indicate the means of perennation, providing a means of noting living plant accessions that require regular curatorial monitoring [ITF-2].

label: Period Explicit
definition: This is an indicator for the explicitness of a period.

label: Phase Or Stage
definition: A property for a phase or a stage of the organism(s) in the unit.

label: Photographic Sensitivity
definition: EXIF term. This tag indicates the sensitivity of the camera or input device when the image was shot.

label: Physical Format
definition: Code or descriptive term for physical format of record.

label: Physical Object ID
definition: Code or descriptive term for identifier of physical item in a collection like a tape number or catalog number of photograph.

label: Platform Name
definition: The platform from which observations or collections were made (e.g. the name of a research vessel or a remote operated vehicle).

label: Playback Used
definition: Boolean flag to indicate whether a playback was used to stimulate singing of the animal to be recorded.

label: Point Radius Spatial Fit
definition: A measure of how well the circle defined by the coordinates and uncertainty match the original spatial representation, as a ratio of the area of the circle to the area of the original spatial representation.

label: Position On Object
definition: The position of the inscription, writing or label on the object.

label: preferred
definition: Meta Property to denote the preferred statement if a property is used more than once for an instance of a class.

label: Preferred Name
definition: The preferred name of a Person.

label: Preparation Materials
definition: Materials and chemicals used in the preparation of the specimen, tissue, DNA or RNA sample.

label: Preparation Type
definition: Description of preparation type (specimens, tissues, DNA).

label: Preparations Text
definition: Textual account of preparation.

label: Preservation Type
definition: Description of preservation type.

label: Previous Unit Text
definition: Alternative text identifying the previous unit when no ABCD standard IDs can be assigned.

label: Previous Units Text
definition: An alternative text identifying the previous units.

label: Product URL
definition: The URL of a web page were the multimedia file is presented, including additional meta information, possibly with the support of web viewers or players.

label: Propagation
definition: Allows for information about any propagation requirements to be passed as free text in order to help the receiving garden propagate the transferred accession [ITF-2] or to record the garden's experience made with this accession.

label: Propagation History Code
definition: A code to indicate the nature of the production of the plant material being accessioned, for use in association with the concept Provenance Category. [ITF-2]

label: Provenance Category
definition: A code to indicate the provenance of the accession [ITF-2].

label: Pulse Distance Regularity
definition: For describing the sound or call of an animal.

label: Pulse Energy Contour
definition: For describing the sound or call of an animal.

label: Pulse Frequency Contour
definition: For describing the sound or call of an animal.

label: Pulse Frequency Modulations
definition: For describing the sound or call of an animal.

label: Pulse Grouping
definition: For describing the sound or call of an animal.

label: Pulse Length
definition: For describing the sound or call of an animal.

label: Pulse Maximum Amplitude
definition: For describing the sound or call of an animal.

label: Pulse Repetition Rate
definition: For describing the sound or call of an animal.

label: Pulse Time Encoded Signal
definition: For describing the sound or call of an animal.

label: Recording Environment
definition: The context or surrounding in which the multimedia object was created.

label: Reference System
definition: The reference system used for measuring, such as the geodetic datum.

label: Resource URI
definition: An preferably resolvable URI to uniquely identify a concept.

label: Result Role
definition: The result role is used to designate the role of the identification result (e.g. substrate, isolate, host, parasite, etc.)

label: Role
definition: The function a Contact fulfills.

label: Sample Designation
definition: Designated number or identifier of sample, usually project number used in the lab.

label: Sample Size
definition: MIxS element. Amount or size of sample (volume, mass or area) that was collected.

label: Sampling Rate
definition: The number of times per second the analog signal is sampled when recording or converting into a digital format, expressed in Kilohertz (kHz).

label: Saturation
definition: This property indicates the direction of saturation processing applied by the camera when the image was shot.

label: Scope
definition: A keyword describing the scope of a class.

label: sequence
definition: Meta Property to denote the sequence of statements on a property which is used more than once for an instance of a class.

label: Sequence Database
definition: The database holding the sequence data.

label: Sequence Length
definition: The length of the sequence in basepairs.

label: Sequenced Part
definition: A description of the actually sequenced material  (DNA/RNA/Protein, Gene or part of gene, completeness, etc.).

label: Serovar Or Serotype
definition: Name and author of the serovar.

label: Sharpness
definition: This property indicates the direction of sharpness processing applied by the camera when the image was shot.

label: Shutter Speed
definition: The APEX (Additive System of Photographic Exposure) value for the shutter speed setting.

label: Sorting Name
definition: The Full Name of a Person in a form appropriate for sorting alphabetically.

label: Source ID
definition: The name or code of a data source (that is unique within the institution and constitutes the second part of the record identifier).

label: Source Institution ID
definition: The unique identifier (code or name) of an institution holding the original data source.

label: Spatial Datum
definition: A mathematical surface on which the mapping and coordinate system used for the geolocation are based.

label: Species Epithet
definition: The first epithet occurring in a scientific name (after genus and, optionally, subgenus names).

label: Spectral Sensitivity
definition: EXIF term. Indicates the spectral sensitivity of each channel of the camera used. The value is an ASCII string compatible with the standard developed by the ASTM Technical committee.

label: Speed
definition: The speed of the recording, indicating if the recording has been speed up (speed > 1) or slowed (speed < 1) down for better human analysis, expressed as a factor of the original speed.

label: Stored Under Flag
definition: This flag is set to "true" to designate the Identification under which the entire Unit is stored (in a physical collection) or otherwise preferably referenced.

label: Strain
definition: The name of a microbial or viral strain

label: Stratigraphy
definition: A free text field for an informal record of the gathering site stratigraphy.

label: Subgenus
definition: The name of a subgenus.

label: Subgenus Author And Year
definition: Author and year of the subgenus name.

label: Subject Distance
definition: Specific distance of the subject represented in the media resource with respect to the acquisition device.

label: Subspecies Epithet
definition: The second epithet of a scientific name of subspecies rank (after Genus, optional subgenus, and species epithet).

label: Syntaxon
definition: A syntaxon name and category assigned to the gathering site.

label: Taphonomy
definition: The life position, allochthonous death assemblage, post mortem history details etc.

label: Taxonomic Term
definition: A taxonomic term (e.g. taxon name of higher rank) describing the taxonomic scope of a data set.

label: Telephone Number
definition: Full telephone or fax number in standard international format.

label: Temperature Value
definition: Concept for a temperature value. Preferably a number.

label: Term
definition: A descriptive term to describe a concept.

label: Term Domain
definition: The subject area of the term list from which the term is drawn.

label: Text
definition: A generic text property to describe a class.

label: Thumbnail URL
definition: The URL of a thumbnail representing the digital object.

label: Time Of Day Begin
definition: The time of day in hours from midnight local time for the beginning of a period.

label: Time Of Day End
definition: The time of day in hours from midnight for the end of a period.

label: Time Span Begin
definition: The beginning of a period or a single point in time expressed in a variant of the W3C DateTime format.

label: Time Span End
definition: The end of a period expressed in a variant of the W3C DateTime format.

label: Title
definition: A short concise title for a class.

label: Trade Designation Name
definition: A trade name used for a specific cultivar.

label: Type Germplasm Storage
definition: Code for the type of storage of the unit in the collection.

label: Type Status
definition: A full term designating the status of the Nomenclatural Type Designation.

label: Unformatted Value
definition: Information about a class in free text form that can not be expressed in atomized values.

label: Unit Of Measurement
definition: The unit of measurement in which the values are expressed.

label: Upper Value
definition: The upper value of a measurement when it yields a range of values.

label: UTM Datum
definition: Mathematical surface on which the mapping and coordinate system used for geocodes are based.

label: UTM Easting
definition: The distance in meters east of the origin of the UTM Zone.

label: UTM Northing
definition: The distance in meters north of the origin for the UTM Subzone.

label: UTM Subzone
definition: The Subzone letter corresponding to one of the 20 North-South divisions of the UTM grid system.

label: UTM Text
definition: An alternative composite text to capture unatomized UTM coordinate data.

label: UTM Zone
definition: The numerical Zone corresponding to the central meridian and origin upon which the UTMEasting is based.

label: UTM Zone Full
definition: An alternative composite text to capture a zone expressed as a combination of UTMZone and UTMSubzone.

label: UTMNS
definition: The hemisphere to which the UTM Northing refers.

label: Valid Distribution Flag
definition: A flag ("true" or "false") that indicates whether the locality information represents a valid distribution occurrence for a specimen.

label: Verbatim Text
definition: The exact transcription of a written or printed text.

label: Verification Level
definition: The level to which the identification has been verified. Different standards may use different values here.

label: Verification Status
definition: A categorical description of the extent to which the georeference has been verified to represent the location where the specimen or observation was collected. This element should be vocabulary-controlled.

label: Video Bitrate
definition: The bit rate of a video stream, usually expressed in kBit/s or MBit/s.

label: Video Encoding
definition: The codec of a video.

label: Viral Species Designation
definition: The formal name for a viral species.

label: was Acquired From
definition: Property to connect a concept to the contact it was acquired from.

label: Website URL
definition: The URL of a web page for the associated class.

label: White Balance
definition: This property indicates the white balance mode set when the image was shot.

label: Width
definition: An image or video width in pixels.

label: WMSURL
definition: A URL for the location of a boundary polygon or centroid spatial reference relating to a gathering site, according to the Web Map Services (WMS) specification of the Open GIS Consortium.
